column1: Develop training materials for our new Code of Conduct.
column3:
Training materials have been 
created and will be rolled out 
during FY20.

column1: Update anti-bribery and create anti-trust policies.
column3:
Anti-bribery policy update is in 
process and anti-trust policy is 
being finalized for roll out 
during FY20.

column1: Prepare for General Data Protection Regulation compliance.
column3:
We executed on our GDPR plan, 
including adoption of a worldwide 
privacy policy, implementation 
of online privacy center to allow 
users to exercise their data subject 
rights, and participation in the 
Privacy Shield.  As part of the 
GDPR plan, we also created and 
rolled out training materials 
to all employees.
